_about: Carbon dioxide (1) + Methanol (2): equilibrium states (T, P, x, y), 313.11-330.03 K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record, compositions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2.

notes: Read with validation/python/hp_gas_solubility.py. The record gives mass fractions; x_1 = (w_1/M_1) / (w_1/M_1 + w_2/M_2) with M_1 = 44.0098, M_2 = 32.04186 g/mol. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
